latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Encoding Format Advisor helps select a data encoding format (JSON, Protobuf, Thrift, Avro) and design robust schema evolution strategies.

- Provides targeted recommendations for encoding format selection across dataflow modes (database storage, service calls, messaging).
- Includes schema evolution planning with clear rules for backward and forward compatibility.
- Highlights per-format compatibility checks and evolution-safe schema change procedures.
- Features troubleshooting for unknown field loss and encoding-induced upgrade issues during rolling deployments.
- Not intended for data model (relational/document/graph) or encryption/compression selection.
